user.title: Set up your MixPad hubs
user.description: Add every MixPad LAN IP using the address list below. Your ORVIBO account is shared by all hubs. Cloud connection is enabled by default: submitting sends your login to the selected ORVIBO server to discover supported lights and periodically read inventory and states. Commands stay local. Turn cloud off for advanced local-only setup. Each entered IP is explicitly trusted. USA is verified; China is upstream-documented only.

local.title: Advanced local-only setup
local.description: Cloud access is disabled. Supply your own gateway UID, exact device IDs and actual endpoints as topology JSON. No cloud requests will be made. For automatic entity import, go back and enable cloud connection.
